draft.title: Health as a resource
card: A resource is something people draw on to do things and meet their needs. Good health is a resource because it gives people the capacity to live the life they want.
Individuals
Good health lets a person work, learn, care for others and enjoy time with family and friends. Poor health can limit these things.
Communities
When many people are healthy, more can volunteer, join clubs and support each other. This builds stronger and more connected communities.
Australia and the world

A healthy population can work and study, so a country can spend less on treating illness and more on other needs. Healthier nations can also trade, share knowledge and work together on global problems.
draft.remember: Good health is a resource because it lets people work, learn and take part, from one person up to the world.

a.q: Why is good health described as a resource for an individual?
opts: It gives the person the capacity to work, learn and join in
It guarantees the person will never become ill or injured
It gives the person a fixed amount of money each year
It means the person no longer needs any health services
a.why: A resource is something people draw on to do things, and good health gives the capacity to work, learn and take part. The option about never becoming ill is tempting, but good health does not guarantee that.
a.clue: A resource is something you draw on to do things.

b.q: In a Victorian town, most residents are in good health. Which outcome best shows health acting as a resource for the community?
opts: More residents are able to volunteer and run local clubs
Residents no longer need to pay any tax to government
Every resident lives to exactly the same age as others
The town has fewer people than it had before
b.why: Healthy residents have the capacity to take part, so more can volunteer and support local groups. That is health acting as a resource. Living to the same age is wrong because good health does not make lifespans identical.
b.clue: Look for the outcome that involves people taking part together.

a.best: It gives the person the capacity to work, learn and join in

b.best: More residents are able to volunteer and run local clubs

proposal.title: Health as a resource
card: A resource is something people draw on to do things. Good health is a resource because it gives people the capacity to work, learn and take part. Hospitals, doctors and insurance support health, but here health itself is the thing being used.
Individuals
Good health lets a person work, study, care for others and spend time with family and friends. Poor health can limit these things.
Communities
When many people are healthy, more can volunteer, join clubs and support each other. This builds stronger, more connected communities.
Australia and the world

A healthy population misses less work and study, so a country produces more and can spend less on treating illness. Healthier nations can also trade, share knowledge and work together on global problems.
proposal.remember: Health is the cause here: being healthy is what lets people, communities and nations do more.

a.q: Which example shows good health acting as a resource for an individual?
opts: Sam stays well, so he can keep working and studying
Sam's family pays for private health insurance
Sam's local clinic hires two more doctors
Sam lives close to a large public hospital
a.why: Sam's good health is what lets him keep working and studying, so health itself is the resource being used. Insurance, clinics and hospitals are tempting, but they are things that support health, not health being drawn on to do things.
a.clue: Is health itself being used, or is something supporting health?

b.q: Which outcome best shows health acting as a resource for Australia as a nation?
opts: Fewer workers take sick leave, so more goods are produced
A stronger economy lets more people pay for health care
Government builds new hospitals in regional areas
More money is spent treating chronic illness each year
b.why: A healthier workforce misses less work, so the country produces more. Health is the cause and the national benefit is the result. The stronger economy option is tempting, but it reverses this: there, money is supporting health rather than health supporting the nation.
b.clue: Check which way it runs: is health the cause or the result?

a.best: Sam stays well, so he can keep working and studying

b.best: Fewer workers take sick leave, so more goods are produced
